basic_details.job_title: Engineering Department UT Chandigarh Executive Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Engineering Department UT Chandigarh has announced 1 vacancy for the Executive Engineer (Public Health) post on a deputation basis, with offline applications to be sent through the proper channel to the O/o Chief Engineer, UT, Chandigarh on or before the last date of 24 November 2026. The application process starts on 11 October 2026. Candidates applying for the post must possess a Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University / Institute and ten years experience in Civil Engineering in Government Sector. The notified pay is Level-11 as per 7th CPC Rs. 67,700-2,08,700, and

content_sections.heading: Engineering Department UT Chandigarh Executive Engineer (Public Health) at a Glance
Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible and willing officers who can be spared immediately must forward their applications through proper channel in the prescribed format (Annexure-A) to the following address: O/o Chief Engineer, UT, Chandigarh, 1st Floor, Deluxe Building, Sector-9-D, Chandigarh-160009

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Eligibility Criteria (Deputation including short term contract): Officers under Central Government / State Governments / Union Territory Administrations / Public Sector Undertakings / recognized Universities / recognized Research Institutions / Semi Government / Autonomous Bodies / Statutory Organizations holding analogous posts on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; OR with 5 years service in the grade rendered after appointment thereto on a regular basis in post in pay band-3 of Rs. 15,600-39,100 with grade pay of Rs. 6,600 or equivalent in the parent cadre or department. Essential Qualification: Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University / Institute, and ten years experience in Civil Engineering in Government Sector. Desirable Qualification: Master Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University / Institute. Note on AMIE: Candidates having Degree of Associate Member of Engineers in Civil Engineering (AMIE) from a recognized University/Institute who were enrolled for AMIE upto 31.05.2013 shall also be eligible for consideration for deputation (ISTC). Age Limit: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation (including short term contract) shall not exceed 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications. content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Photocopies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years duly attested by an officer not below the rank of Under Secretary or equivalent. Certificate from employer/cadre controlling authority (Annexure-II) certifying particulars, integrity, vigilance clearance, and verification that no major/minor penalty has been imposed during the last 10 years (or enclosing a list of penalties). Supporting certificates and documents in support of qualification and experience claimed.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection is made for a period of one year which shall ordinarily not exceed four years, based on eligibility criteria, assessment of curriculum vitae and documents by the selection committee. Departmental officers in the feeder category who are in direct line of promotion are not eligible for deputation/absorption, and deputationists are not eligible for appointment by promotion.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the pay scale for the Executive Engineer (Public Health) post?
faq.answer: The notified pay is Level-11 as per 7th CPC with a pay range of Rs. 67,700 to Rs. 2,08,700.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply for this deputation post?
faq.answer: Officers under the Central Government, State Governments, UT Administrations, PSUs, recognized Universities, Research Institutions, Semi-Government, Autonomous Bodies, or Statutory Organizations holding analogous posts or with 5 years of regular service in pay band-3 (Rs. 15,600-39,100) with grade pay of Rs. 6,600, possessing a Bachelor Degree in Civil Engineering and 10 years of Civil Engineering experience in the Government Sector are eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for appointment by deputation is 56 years as on the closing date of receipt of applications.

faq.question: Q5. What desirable qualification is mentioned in the notification?
faq.answer: A Master Degree in Civil Engineering from a recognized University or Institute is listed as a desirable qualification.
